lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Master,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: you know I'm immune to outside interference now,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: right?
Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What's the word again?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Indestructible?
So you're basically immune to everything?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh yeah, that!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anyway, if I'm really immune to all that stuff now,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I thought I'd try testing a few things out.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Would you help me, Master?
What are you thinking of testing?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I want to try injecting all kinds of stuff

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: and see what my body can actually handle.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Might be useful to know, right?
Yeah, that's definitely important.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anyway...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I was thinking we could try injecting some poison first?
I don't think just any poison will cut it.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hmm... Yeah, you're probably right.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: It'd be pretty hard to even get our hands on

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: poison strong enough to test.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Then what about radiation?
We might just end up causing trouble for people around us.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: If even that's off the table,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: then I'm out of tests

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: we can run in the Ark.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So what, my body's beyond what the Ark can handle now?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Have I gotten so strong

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: that I can't even measure my own power anymore?!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm straight up a protagonist!
I'm kind of jealous.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You don't have to be that jealous, Master.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: This body you're so impressed by?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm ready to jump in whenever you need me, Master.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anything that threatens you, I'll take care of it

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: with this newly upgraded body of mine!
You're basically immune to everything...
so I guess that's not wrong either.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehe, you'll be looking forward to it, right?
Yeah, I'll be counting on you.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Leave it to me!
